correctness.rationale: The matrix has an exact 2x2 active block with trace κ+p+(p−1)(κ−1)w and determinant κp; the characteristic polynomial at one is (κ−1)(p−1)(1−w)≤0 so the condition number is precisely the active eigenvalue ratio. Its normalized trace is (a/√p+b√p)/√κ, minimized over p∈(0,1] exactly at min(1,a/b), yielding the 45-degree barrier, sharp minimum and nominal threshold. Gaussian decomposition produces independent χ²_1 and χ²_(n−1) variables, the F-tail and χ² limit. A runnable checker verified 2234 finite exact/numeric configurations, plus nominal-scale identities; finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The model is the simplest nontrivial case of a spectral LMP built from an approximate eigenvector, widely used in numerical linear solves and data assimilation. Its conditioning can deteriorate even though the preconditioner remains SPD. The universal 45-degree boundary separates unrecoverable by shrinking from useful approximate directions, and the nominal inverse-scale boundary quantifies how scaling errors matter. Exact F survival probabilities yield power-budget versus dimension reliability guidance; these are natural quantities, not arbitrary parameter slicing. Limits on full PCG convergence are explicit.
